abuse_case: User changes a record ID in URL/API to read another student
control: Object-level authorization on every request; programme/company scope

abuse_case: Student forges request to alter own status or CTC
control: No student write on protected fields; server validation; audit
test: Forged-request test returns denied + audit entry

abuse_case: Client bypasses disabled button or replays stale eligibility result
control: Re-run policy check at commit inside a transaction
Throttling, framework password hashing, secure cookies, expiry, MFA for privileged where feasible
test: Brute-force test; cookie inspection; logout test

abuse_case: Malformed file, spreadsheet formula injection, unauthorised download
control: Type/size allow-list, parse as data, formula-safe CSV, per-request authorization, export audit
test: Malicious CSV test; formula-cell export test

abuse_case: Operator edits/deletes audit history; secrets in logs
control: Append-only access, restricted log access, no secrets in logs

abuse_case: Rules edited by ordinary user or supplied as executable input
control: Rules in code module, versioned, not user-editable

abuse_case: Vulnerable package, exposed secret, debug mode on
control: Pinned deps, scans, env-based secrets, deployment checklist

abuse_case: Bulk import or repeated requests overload app; backup not restorable
Shared admin account or access not removed after role change
Drill-down or filter leaks out-of-scope data
control: Same backend permissions as record views; scope filters
test: Scope tests with multi-role synthetic data
